exampleEn: This policy may give rise to unintended consequences.
exampleKo: 이 정책은 예기치 않은 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다.
gameExamples: The new regulations might give rise to increased competition among businesses.
His reckless behavior could give rise to many safety concerns in the community.
A lack of communication can give rise to misunderstandings in a relationship.
